items.docs: Public informational page describing how clinicians order Caris molecular profiling tests via the Caris+Portal, manual requisition forms, or EHR integration. Informational HTML only; no programmatic ordering endpoint is documented.

Public informational page listing supported EHR integration partners and the orders-and-results integration model. Partner integrations are provisioned individually; no public integration API specification is published.
